facts.value: Always delegates attachment-position correction to fn_800DAD18. That helper adds the linked attachment minus current XRotN XYZ displacement to cur_pos and returns the strict pre-correction test delta.y > common.x3C4 * x34_scale.y. Only on true does this callback request CaptureDamageHi at cur_anim_frame with Ft_MF_UpdateCmd, rate 1, float 0 and NULL, reapply setup and pair alignment, optionally dispatch fn_800DC384 through ft_80083C00 when x2226_b2 is clear, and copy the final cur_pos to the model root. The nested callback may already have requested CaptureDamageLw before the model copy. Equality and unordered threshold comparisons do not take the Hi branch, but position arithmetic still runs; no positivity or finite-value guard exists.

Entry routines request frame zero and clear capturedamage.x4; situation-switch helpers request the existing frame with Ft_MF_UpdateCmd, reapply capture setup and pair alignment, and Hi-switch paths explicitly synchronize model translation. The Lw environment dispatch is literally conditioned on !ft_80082708; its gameplay loss-of-support interpretation remains unresolved because the current enum-returning predicate yields GA_Ground=0 for the invoked case.
